categories.main_business_segments: Huanlejia Food Group primarily operates in the food and beverage industry, focusing on the research, production, and sales of plant-based protein beverages (notably coconut juice), fruit canned foods (especially orange and yellow peach cans), juice drinks, and lactic acid bacteria beverages. The company’s core products include coconut juice beverages and fruit canned foods, which hold significant market recognition in China.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced aseptic cold filling technology for PET bottles, a domestic first for neutral plant protein beverages with fruit pulp. It has developed proprietary technologies such as aseptic cold filling with fruit pulp addition, automated peeling and pitting for canned oranges and peaches, secondary homogenization for coconut juice, and vacuum extraction for peach pulp. These innovations enhance product quality, safety, and shelf life while maintaining nutritional value.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Huanlejia serves a broad consumer base through multiple channels including distributors, supermarkets, catering, and key accounts, as well as online platforms like JD.com, Tmall, Pinduoduo, and Douyin. Its products target health-conscious consumers interested in plant-based protein beverages and convenient canned fruit foods, with a focus on both traditional retail and emerging snack specialty chains.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Guangdong (Zhanjiang), Hubei (Hanchuan and Zhijiang), and Shandong (Linyi). It has a nationwide sales network covering central, eastern, southwestern, northern, northwestern, northeastern, and southern China regions. Additionally, it has subsidiaries in Hong Kong and Vietnam to support overseas raw material processing and business expansion.
categories.supply_chain_position: Huanlejia operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and sales of finished food and beverage products. It is extending upstream into raw material processing, notably through its coconut processing project in Vietnam, to strengthen raw material supply and enhance supply chain competitiveness.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities include dual-driven growth focusing on coconut juice and fruit canned products, channel diversification, brand building, and upstream raw material supply chain integration. R&D efforts emphasize product innovation in health, taste, and packaging, with increased investment in developing new beverage and canned food products aligned with consumer trends toward natural, healthy, and sustainable foods.
categories.revenue_model: Huanlejia generates revenue primarily through product sales via multiple channels: predominantly buyout sales to distributors (over 85% of revenue), supplemented by direct sales through e-commerce platforms and consignment sales. It also derives income from raw material trading, rental income, and other ancillary services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading player in the Chinese plant protein beverage and fruit canned food markets, ranking among the top five nationally in coconut juice products and holding the number one cumulative sales position in fruit canned foods for eight consecutive years according to Frost & Sullivan. It competes in a highly fragmented and competitive food manufacturing industry with many small and medium enterprises.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Huanlejia reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.85 billion, a slight decline of 3.53% year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 147 million, down 47.06%. The company’s total assets were about RMB 2.05 billion with a net asset value of RMB 1.13 billion. Despite recent profit declines, the company maintains a solid market presence and continues investing in capacity expansion and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Huanlejia emphasizes product quality, safety, and innovation, leveraging proprietary aseptic cold filling technology to deliver fresh-tasting, nutritious plant protein beverages with fruit pulp. Its fruit canned products benefit from advanced automated processing technologies ensuring high quality and convenience. The company’s extensive and deep sales network, combined with diversified channels and strong brand recognition, differentiates it in a competitive market focused on health, sustainability, and consumer experience.
